args.question:
Evergreen Catering (V-137) has two approved invoices, so I haven't paid anything yet. Which one should I pay by wire from the operating account?
- INV-36076: $2,242.76, due 2026-11-04
- INV-48634: $4,683.93, due 2026-11-25
(There is also INV-36712, $1,601.80, which is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-52947, $8,746.27, which is already paid.) Reply with the invoice ID and I'll send the wire for the full amount, once.
